title: An A minor pentatonic box
summary: Use five notes in a small area.

steps.title: An A minor pentatonic box
steps.body:
Use the **pentatonic scale** from the earlier lesson in a **scale box** between frets 5 and 8. Start with A2 on string 6, fret 5; finish with A3 on string 4, fret 7.

**Why it matters:** This small route lets you practise the sounds and string changes together, without learning the whole neck at once.

steps.title: Find the notes
steps.body: Follow string 6 frets 5, 8; string 5 frets 5, 7; string 4 frets 5, 7. The six positions give five different notes and the higher A.

items.prompt: Play A, C, D, E, G, A in that order, one note at a time.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Play the route slowly, then invent a short tune using its middle four notes. Return to A to hear home.
